title: feat(billing): add support for annual subscription plans
author: priya-n
body: Adds annual plan selection to the checkout flow with prorated upgrades.

title: fix: resolve crash when uploading files over 50MB
author: dmitri-k
body: The multipart handler ran out of memory on large uploads. Now streams to disk.

title: perf: reduce dashboard load time by caching aggregate queries
author: sam-oyelaran
body: Dashboard p95 went from 3.2s to 0.9s by caching the rollup query for 60s.

title: feat!: remove deprecated /v1/reports endpoint
author: priya-n
body: BREAKING: /v1/reports is removed. Consumers must migrate to /v2/reports.

title: docs: document the webhook retry policy
author: lena-m
body: Adds a page explaining exponential backoff and the 24h retry window.

title: fix(auth): session no longer expires early on Safari
author: dmitri-k
body: SameSite cookie attribute was causing premature logout in Safari 17.

title: ci: run the integration suite on pull requests
author: sam-oyelaran
body: Moves integration tests from nightly to per-PR.

title: feat(search): add filters for date range and status
author: lena-m
body: Users can now narrow search results by created date and record status.

title: refactor: extract notification logic into its own service
author: priya-n
body: No behaviour change. Prepares for the upcoming SMS channel.

title: fix: correct timezone handling in scheduled exports
author: dmitri-k
body: Exports scheduled for 9am were firing at 9am UTC regardless of user timezone.

title: feat(admin): bulk user import from CSV
author: sam-oyelaran
body: Admins can upload a CSV to create up to 5,000 users at once.

title: test: add coverage for the rate limiter
author: lena-m

title: perf: lazy-load report charts to cut initial bundle by 340KB
author: priya-n
body: Charting library is now code-split and loaded on demand.
